explanation: Bounds the threshold value used by the physical cumulative guard. The estimate includes the representation cap and the false score of the generated auxiliary pool, not a caller-supplied score bound.
theorem_title: An eighth-power bound for the actual dense threshold
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.wanted_threshold_le {n nA nB nC q : ℕ}
    (A B C : ℕ→ℤ) (rs : List _root_.ThreeSum.BandCandidateRows.Record) (hrs : rs.length≤3*n^2) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.GlobalEncoding.representationCap (_root_.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.half n) (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.blocks n)*
      _root_.ThreeSum.LightDenseSetup.falseScore (_root_.ThreeSum.LightPrimePool.prime (_root_.ThreeSum.Scales.primeWindow n))
        (_root_.ThreeSum.LightPrimePool.size (_root_.ThreeSum.Scales.primeWindow n)) q nA nB nC (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BandScales.bandSize n) A B C rs≤
      9*(_root_.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.magnitude n)^8 := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let natural size and source-length controls, modulus $q$, integer source functions, and owner-record list be arbitrary, with at most $3n^2$ owner records. The representation cap at the executable local parameters multiplied by the false score computed with the actual generated prime pool is at most $$9M(n)^8,$$ where $M$ is the reporting magnitude envelope.

Bounds the threshold value used by the physical cumulative guard. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
